header: Places to join and how active each is
lead: Forum, chat, user group, mailing list or code repository. Each gets a card with its purpose and roughly how many people are there.
note: Put member counts in each description. They go out of date quickly, so round them or leave them out.

places.title: Two to six places
places.description: A card with a link is clickable as a whole, and the title names the link for screen readers.

places.title: Equal weight
places.description: A forum of 1,000 and a meet-up of 9 are both places to go, so neither card is larger.

places.title: Size goes in the description
places.description: Not in the shared note, which applies to every place at once.

places.title: Two to four columns
places.description: Plus an optional image between the intro and the grid, if the group has a good photo.
